name: @telorun/http-signature
description: Telo http-signature module — the HTTP signature grammar shared by transports: the RFC 9421 signature base, Signature-Input / Signature structured fields (RFC 9651), Content-Digest (RFC 9530) and webhook base parts. Never published: the code ships inside the module artifact as a pkg:telo/local/js bundle and a transport reaches it through the module's exports.code specifier.
